title: Trusted Match Product Filter
description: A filter on Trusted Match Protocol (TMP) support, by provider and response type.

providers.description: Filter to products with specific TMP providers and match types. Each entry identifies a provider by agent_url and optionally requires specific match capabilities. Products must match at least one entry.

response_types.description: Filter to products supporting specific TMP response types (e.g., 'activation', 'creative', 'catalog_items'). Products must support at least one of the listed types.
